title: Leakage-Free Evaluation and Distribution-Robust Spatio-Temporal Graph Learning for Inductive Kriging
abstract: arXiv:2509.23631v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inductive kriging estimates values at unobserved locations from sparse sensor data, enabling continuous field reconstruction when dense deployment is impractical. However, common 2 x 2 and 2 x 3 evaluation protocols can leak spatial information through model selection and obscure true out-of-distribution (OOD) behavior. We propose a leakage-free 3 x 3 partition that separates training, validation, and testing in both space and time, so that model fitting, checkpoint selection, and final reporting are performed on distinct spatio-temporal domains. translated_title: 无泄漏评估与分布鲁棒的归纳克里金时空图学习
translated_abstract: 归纳克里金方法从稀疏传感器数据估计未观测位置的值，在密集部署不可行时能够实现连续场重建。然而，常见的2×2和2×3评估协议可能通过模型选择泄漏空间信息，并掩盖真实的分布外（OOD）行为。我们提出一种无泄漏的3×3分区方法，在空间和时间上同时分离训练、验证和测试集，使得模型拟合、检查点选择和最终报告在不同的时空域上进行。在这种更严格的设置下，我们引入了DRIK（分布鲁棒归纳克里金）框架，包含三种任务特定机制：空间连续性正则化（SCR）扰动坐标以减少对单一离散化图的依赖；掩码流消歧（MFD）剪除来自零填充掩码节点的模糊传播；以及结构域扩展（SDE）利用验证集进行...（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出无泄漏的3×3时空分区评估协议和DRIK框架，通过三种机制（SCR、MFD、SDE）实现分布鲁棒的归纳克里金估计，解决传统评估中的信息泄漏和分布外泛化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a leakage-free 3×3 spatio-temporal partition protocol and the DRIK framework with three mechanisms (SCR, MFD, SDE) for distribution-robust inductive kriging, addressing information leakage and out-of-distribution generalization issues in conventional evaluation.
